sum: Ingests documents of any format and builds a self-hosted knowledge graph from them, so retrieval traverses relations instead of ranking chunks.

evidence.co.standards: cites standards_conformance.evidence: conforms to 1 of the 5 neutral interface standards (AGENTS.md)
evidence.se.residency: cites data_residency: self-hostable, the state leaves the machine but the operator can own the service; keys are the operator's own (byok)
evidence.se.threats: cites th and ctrl: T1/T6 introduced, controls memval none, log part
evidence.fx.exit: artifact.format store: a store the tool owns; what survives removal depends on an export path
evidence.sf.reach: restates exec, ctrl and data_residency: the entry does not execute code itself, but self-hostable means its state reaches a service, and no egress control is recorded
evidence.co.coexist: states the hosts it sits beside: Claude Code, Cursor, Cline (README.md)
evidence.ic.help: a command-line parser that prints its own usage: cognee-mcp/src/server.py (argparse)
evidence.rl.resume: recovering is described in prose, not implemented: SESSION_POSTGRES_CACHE_PLAN.md (checkpoint)
evidence.se.attest: signs or attests what it publishes: .github/workflows/dev_canary_release.yml (attest-build-provenance)
evidence.fx.install: an install that does not change the machine globally: docs/docker-colima-setup.md (docker run)
evidence.fx.byo: the provider is the operator's choice: OPENAI, OLLAMA, LITELLM, BEDROCK, LMSTUDIO, VLLM (README.md)

pre: a graph or vector store to run behind it
enough material that traversal beats reading the files
anti: a repository small enough to read directly, where the index costs more than it saves
teams that cannot operate another datastore
gnote: Ingesting arbitrary documents into a graph an agent then trusts is the memory-poisoning path in its most direct form: whoever can add a document can add a belief. No validation step on write is recorded.

ja.sum: 任意形式の文書を取り込み、自己ホストの知識グラフを構築する。チャンクを順位付けるのではなく関係を辿って検索する。
ja.art: 知識グラフとベクトルインデックス（永続）
pre: 背後で動かすグラフまたはベクトルストア
ファイルを直接読むより走査が勝つだけの分量
anti: 直接読める規模のリポジトリ。索引のほうが高くつく
データストアをもう1つ運用できないチーム
ja.gnote: 任意の文書をグラフに取り込み、エージェントがそれを信じるという構図は、記憶汚染の最も直接的な経路である。文書を足せる者が信念を足せる。書き込み時の検証手順は記録されていない。
